Plants of the World Online account: Coleus hadiensis (Forssk.) A.J.Paton.

The native range of this species is Egypt to S. Africa, SW. Arabian Peninsula, Maldives, Sri Lanka. It is a sometimes tuberous subshrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.
